newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Vienna stocks fall, upside potential limited.
newsitem.headline: Vienna stocks fall, upside potential limited.

text.p: Austrian shares ended moderately in negative territory on Tuesday after see-saw trade with a lack of incentives restricting activity to a few select issues.
Traders said activity was brisk in early morning after a batch of nine-month earnings results, but soon petered out.
Traders see scant potential for significant gains over the short term. "There's a lack of interest at present. Nothing really catches the imagination," said one.

The ATX index of 21 blue chips lost 0.31 percent, or 3.31 points, to 1,081.14 after trading within a 1,079.73 to 1,086.30 point range. Of its constituents, five gained, 14 fell and two were unchanged.
The ATX is seen supported at just below 1,080 points, with upside potential seen in EVN, OMV, Creditanstalt's preferred and ordinary shares, and Wienerberger, said another trader.
Traders cited keen demand for OMV after nine-month results came out at the top end of analysts' expectations and the company said it would pay out a higher dividend for 1996.
OMV initially rose to 1,097 schillings before profittaking kicked in and knocked it down to 1,084.3, down 0.7 schillings on the day.
Not faring so well after nine-month results was high-grade steelmaker Boehler-Uddeholm, which dropped seven schillings to 753 after reporting a 22-percent fall in net profit.
But the day's best performing blue chip, albeit on meagre volume of just 200 lots compared to OMV's 44,000, was Lenzing, gaining 1.42 percent to 680.
Lenzing announced a slight increase in nine-month sales and reiterated it expects to post a loss for the full year.
The day's poorest performer and most actively traded was Vienna airport operator Flughafen, shedding 2.88 percent to 505 on turnover of more than 54,000 shares.
"The sell order's still not completed," said one trader, expecting further downside in Flughafen.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index fell 0.14 percent to 414.36 points.
The December ATX future lost 3.9 points to 1,083 with 225 lots traded.
